commonProcedure:
MD196-COMMON — KEEP all six exact native cards and eight class-access rows. Each root is Action,120 feet,V/S/F,rank9,base26RP,minimum actual casting-class level17. Five are Wizard only; Unmake also Cleric and Mage. Actual Wizard/Mage INT or Cleric WIS and acquired school bonuses determine DC. A legal source profile, real known/prepared route, voice, usable somatic hand, focus and permitted Action are prerequisites. Sufficient level/RP alone grants no spell. No generic upcast, extra targets, higher rank or automatic school union.
Preflight known illegality before paying. Freeze targets, mode, source identity, hostility/knowledge selectors and optional choices. Commit actual Action, RP and non-RP costs once, update protected class cadence and Refrain, make any genuine concentration transition, then permit the actual cast-time counter window. A failed save, absent privately selected spell, immunity, counter or later loss after legal commitment refunds nothing. An already committed parent does not overwrite a later interrupt's resource history. Source effects resolve only after surviving interruption. Wizard class Counterspell is acquired rank1/3RP/Reaction60feet/recharge2, INT+PB versus DC28 for these rank9 roots; Wizard Arch Dispel is rank3/3RP/Action60feet/recharge2 and INT+PB versus DC19 for an actual perceivable rank9 ongoing effect. These are different checks; no Greater Dispel acquisition is assumed.
Direct single-target casts require a known perceived body and caster line of effect within120feet, not visual sight unless the source demands it. Total cover excludes direct paths; no targeting through an opaque wall because a location is known. Mass Willbreaker's explicit all-enemy query is the separately selected area rule below. Actual mental defenses are component-specific. None of the six inherently inflicts Charmed or Frightened. Mind Blank's current Abjuration mode covers their actual mental spell components, including native mental Stunned; psychic damage immunity alone does not. True Seeing recognizes actual false perception, not every Illusion-school effect. Source class grants, physiological life, objective identity, soul and original history are distinct from current subjective belief and accessible memory.
All actor regular starts/ends are independently recorded. Regular starts refresh permitted budgets and tick positive recharge exactly once even if unable to act; ending idle turns vent only under the actual class rule. Spent budgets remain spent when a prohibition ends. Explicit elapsed deadlines continue during absence, suppression or loading. Bare hostile rounds use future target regular END markers excluding the current in-progress turn, end triggers phase10 and expiry phase20. Attached companions use their genuine future attached phase endpoints with the owner's preserved regular cycle, not an invented independent turn; outside initiative use6seconds/round. True extra turns neither advance regular clocks nor create recharge/Ready resets; an extra Action is not a turn. A positive inserted-turn actor remains held without its acquired source. No pulse scheduler is introduced.
Ordinary Ready actually casts/pays/provides components and starts concentration at preparation. Expiry is next own regular START; release needs the actual trigger, current legal Reaction, target/range/line and hold. No second cast/payment/counter window occurs. The distinct new gates below expressly state whether completed release is blocked. Ending a cast restriction does not restore an expired hold. Full commitment and release histories survive serialization.
Same-caster new concentration independently displaces the old concentration at commitment, before any save/counter. No failed replacement restores it. Repeated legal applications need new costs and actual defenses; blocked admission creates no latent application. Hard denial is claimed only by a successfully established whole-Action-equivalent component. Mind Collapse Stunned claims it. These proposed Willbreaker, private boundary prison, knowledge loss, single-spell prohibition and class-availability/belief components preserve basic Actions and voluntary agency, so do not claim that guard. Making a future implementation remove all Actions would require new review, not this classification. A spent guard never refunds after removal/suppression.
Store complete source-owned components, full underlying capability and memory versions, application order, original deadlines, costs, resources, custody, concentration endings and per-recipient decisions. Suppression never rewinds physical consequences, repeats an initial save, replays commands or restores ended sources. When an actual source is unavailable, record an unavailable branch with no invented acquisition, event outcome or cure. No spell here supplies a soul operation, a real plane, global memory access, or a time/history rewrite.
procedure:
NEW UM196-SELECT: one perceived actual enemy and one exact spell identity named before commitment, supported by caster knowledge of that identity through real own learning/observation/credible source. No repertoire scan. Initial INT save is NEW, selected to resist actual memory erasure; success no loss. Hidden absence or lack of an actual recorded knowledge version after legal commitment yields no new seal and no special reason/refund. This selects one identity, not whole school/class, aliases or unrelated similarly named modes. NEW a genuinely acquired version already masked by an existing Unmake seal remains an eligible recorded source for another paid seal; this is no public read of its contents. Truly never-known identity has no such version.

NEW UM196-IDENTITY: establish an indefinite nonconcentration magical erasure/seal for that same spell identity across all of this recipient's actual known/book/prepared, innate/class-spell, temporary-learning and later-acquired routes. Retain acquisition history and external formula/ownership. Covered routes cannot begin a new cast of the selected spell while seal operates, including an actual wrapper invoking that same terminal spell. A nonspell technique, someone else's casting, captured already-cast effect or mere item use not defined as casting is not that spell cast. No blanket suppression of other spells or class engine. Initial source existence must be proved; a historic expired grant alone is not currently remembered unless actual source retains it. NEW UM196-MODE-BINDING: for this spell only, a current ordinary catalog identity and acquired spell-tagged class cards with the exact same printed name are one selected spell family for casting prohibition, while every distinct rank, cost and acquisition mode remains recorded. This is an explicit local identity choice, not a global catalog merge. Differently named aliases require exact separate evidence and are not inferred. Selecting an actually known class mode binds that family even when its ordinary mode is not currently known; a later mode does not evade the existing prohibition.

UM196-TIMING: spell casting already committed before erasure may resolve; a completed paid Ready release is not a new cast and remains legal with its real Reaction, hold, range and target. Ongoing effects/concentration remain under their own dependencies. Incomplete long work that still requires current knowledge fails when that predicate is lost, costs retained. World Rewrite194 supplies ever-known access including real expired Communion grant; it cannot bypass this explicitly operative terminal-identity casting prohibition. Nothing erases its immutable acquisition evidence. A legal World recast after actual seal suppression/removal still pays root26 and every retained payload cost. Perfect Spell remains held CC194-B01; no positive bypass is certified.

NEW UM196-RECOVERY: choose indefinite magical seal rather than unsourced permanent account deletion, explicitly reconciling Instantaneous as establishment of ongoing loss. No rest, level-up, respec, borrowed grant, copied notes, new book or relearning bypass while active. Actual qualified dispel or suppression acts on the ongoing seal; removal exposes original still-valid routes, not obsolete temporary grants, and supplies no free preparation, payment or lost book. Genuine new learning outside the seal must obey its source; no generic memory-repair spell is invented. Reapplication creates source-owned seals with union identity prohibition; removing one leaves another. Caster death does not end it; continuing target death/return preserves it under actual lifecycle evidence only.
